pick.headline: US Marine Lt Col Higgins kidnapped in Lebanon
pick.summary: On February 17, 1988, Lieutenant Colonel William Higgins, the US Marine officer heading a UN truce observer group in southern Lebanon, was abducted near Tyre.
pick.significance: His captors accused him of working for the CIA. He was later killed, and a videotape of his body was released in July 1989.
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of February 19, 1988, listed under Lebanon "More on U.S. Kidnapping Victim Lt Col Higgins", with Voice of Lebanon reporting the kidnappers wanted an exchange and Amal saying it had "clues" to the abductors.

alternates.headline: China invades Vietnam
alternates.summary: On February 17, 1979, Chinese forces attacked across Vietnam's northern border in what Beijing called a punitive war.
alternates.significance: The month-long war, launched weeks after Deng Xiaoping's visit to Washington, tested the Sino-Soviet split and the Soviet-Vietnamese alliance.
alternates.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of February 21, 1979, listed under Cuba a GRANMA editorial condemning the Chinese attack on Vietnam and statements of support for the SRV from workers and mass organizations.
